scope: Four norway_4_lv_grids only; industrial data is not processed.
P/Q series use the verified profile-to-bus mapping and aggregate consumers per physical bus.
No neural network is trained and no test metric is calculated.

pq_definitions.pearson: Pearson correlation over finite P/Q pairs
pq_definitions.q_over_p: Q/P over finite samples with P != 0

topology_definitions.radial_tree: one connected component, edge_count = node_count - 1, and networkx tree check
topology_definitions.cumulative_r: sum of branch r along the selected root-to-node path
topology_definitions.cumulative_x: sum of branch x along the selected root-to-node path
topology_definitions.cumulative_physical_line_length: sum of extra-file Length [km] along the path

pq_information.aggregation: sum profiles sharing mapped physical bus, separately for P and Q

summary.q_independent_dynamic_information_assess: evaluate per-bus values and rule counts; no conclusion is imposed
